stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"Almost every row of the tracks table carries a date warning mark; the repeated warnings clutter the table though one note at the top would do.","where":"the warning marks in the table rows","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Can't tell which company the first group (and some mid-page groups) belongs to; the group heading is hidden under the sticky column headers
Returns are shown before fees, which makes the reader less sure of the choice
Fees are 2025 averages, almost a year older than the returns
The '123 מקור · מחושב · הזנתה' legend is confusing; the reader doesn't know what 'הזנתה' means
The yellow 'not updated since September 2026' warning is worrying and seems to contradict the bottom date of 03.11.2026
The 'כללי 12' filter wasn't obvious until afterwards, and several investment-type button labels were confusing
The table is very long, about 15 screens of scrolling
The Ayalon group has nothing to compare: all rows are new, 'עוד לא דווח', '0 מיליון ₪'
The round charts and two rings mean nothing; '101%' shares makes no sense
Many rows show 'פחות מ־3/5 שנים', so they can't be judged
Jargon such as סחיר, גמיש, קיימי and משולב is never explained
Unclear whether 99% מט"ח is good or bad
'עוד לא דווח' leaves unclear what fee a new track actually charges
Unclear difference between 'S&P 500' and 'עוקב מדד s&p 500'
No information on how much each track lost in a market drop or worst year
No return after fees already worked out
No tax information for over-60s (pension vs lump sum)
No information on whether tracks can be switched later and at what cost
No information on whether the fee can be negotiated
No information on how to open an account or the minimum amount
No plain-language risk line for each investment type
Would drop the 'מההפקדות' fee line, since it is almost always 0%
Would drop the 3-year return if only one return can stay

problems.why: The reader only says they ignored the small clock icons next to every number and never complains that the repeated per-row warnings clutter the table or should be one note at the top.
